units.source_text: 信辅从小学开始，就很喜欢阅读图书。

en.t: From elementary school onward, Shinsuke loved reading books.

units.source_text: 他父亲书箱底部的那本帝国文库本《水浒传》是引起他阅读兴趣的源头。

en.t: The Imperial Library edition of Water Margin at the bottom of his father's book chest was the source that awakened his interest in reading.

units.source_text: 这个只有一个大脑袋的瘦弱小学生，靠着昏暗的灯光，读了很多遍《水浒传》。

en.t: This frail elementary school boy, whose large head was his only striking feature, read Water Margin over and over by dim lamplight.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，即使他合上书本，

en.t: Nor was that all; even after he closed the book,

units.source_text: 脑子里仍然始终想象替天行道的旗帜，景阳冈山上的老虎，菜园子张青在屋梁上挂着的人腿。

en.t: his mind still constantly pictured the banner of acting for Heaven, the tiger on Jingyang Ridge, and the human legs that Zhang Qing the Vegetable Gardener had hung from the rafters.

units.source_text: 这些都是想象吗？

en.t: Were all these merely imagination?

units.source_text: ——可是这种想象比现实还要真实。

en.t: Yet this imagination was even more real than reality.

units.source_text: 他曾经数次手里拿着木剑，在挂着晒干菜的院子里和《水浒传》书中里人物——一丈青扈三娘、花和尚鲁智深，打个落花流水。

en.t: More than once, wooden sword in hand, he had fought the characters from Water Margin in the yard where dried greens were hanging, soundly defeating Yi Zhangqing Hu Sanniang and the Flowery Monk Lu Zhishen.

units.source_text: 三十多年以来，这种激情一直在他心头支持着他。

en.t: For more than thirty years, this passion had continued to sustain him in his heart.

units.source_text: 他记得自己曾经很多天彻夜不眠的阅读书籍。

en.t: He remembered spending many days reading books through the night without sleep.

units.source_text: 不，不仅仅是这样，

en.t: No, it was not only that.

units.source_text: 不管是坐在书桌前、车上，还是上厕所的时候——偶尔甚至连走路的时候也会沉溺在阅读之中。

en.t: Whether he was sitting at his desk, in a vehicle, or in the toilet, and sometimes even while walking, he would lose himself in reading.

units.source_text: 从《水浒传》之后，他没再拿起过木剑。

en.t: After Water Margin, he never picked up a wooden sword again.

units.source_text: 然而，他曾经多次因为那本书里的情节哭哭笑笑。

en.t: Yet many times he had cried and laughed over the plots in those books.

units.source_text: 换言之，已经进入了“完全移情”的忘我境界。

en.t: In other words, he had already entered a self-forgetting state of complete empathy.

units.source_text: 就连他自己也简直成了书里的人物了。

en.t: He himself had all but become one of the characters in the books.

units.source_text: 曾经，他就像天竺佛祖一样转世了无数次。

en.t: At one time, like the Buddha of India, he had been reincarnated countless times.

units.source_text: 他变成了伊凡·卡拉马佐夫、哈姆雷特、安德烈公爵、唐璜、梅菲斯特、列那狐等等。

en.t: He became Ivan Karamazov, Hamlet, Prince Andrei, Don Juan, Mephistopheles, Reynard the Fox, and others.

units.source_text: ——并且，这不是一时的移情忘我。

en.t: And this was not a momentary spell of empathy and self-forgetfulness.

units.source_text: 在一个晚秋的中午之后，因为想要讨要一些零花钱，他去拜访上了年纪的叔父。

en.t: One afternoon in late autumn, wanting to ask for a little pocket money, he went to visit his elderly uncle.

units.source_text: 叔父是长州萩人，他故意在叔父不停的夸奖明治维新的卓越成绩，

en.t: His uncle was from Hagi in Choshu, and he deliberately kept praising the outstanding achievements of the Meiji Restoration in front of him,

units.source_text: 从村田清风，到山县有朋等长州出身的人，都夸赞个不停。

en.t: lavishing praise without end on people from Choshu, from Murata Seifu to Yamagata Aritomo.

units.source_text: 然而，他自己也觉得这个充满虚伪激情、神色苍白的文弱高中生，与其说是当时的大导寺信辅，毋宁说是《红与黑》里的主人公于——年轻的连·索海尔。

en.t: Yet he himself felt that this pale, frail high school student, full of false passion, was less the Daidoji Shinsuke of that time than the young Julien Sorel, the hero of The Red and the Black.
